description: Copy a file from the server's file roots (file_roots) to the device, overwriting a file of the same name there. To install an APK use adb_install instead. The reverse is adb_pull.

device_path.description: Destination on the device, e.g. /sdcard/Download/file.apk or /data/local/tmp/.

host_path.description: Absolute path of the file on the server, inside file_roots.

serial.description: Device serial from adb_devices. Optional when exactly one device is connected.

name: adb_push
title: Push file to device
